resolutions.resolution: Implemented strict atomic file creation using [System.IO.FileStream]::new with FileMode::CreateNew, failing on collisions without modifying bytes, and outputting to stdout when OutputPath is omitted.

Enforced KEEP_ACTIVE evaluation for all active infrastructure (.github, .gitignore, active directories/control files, triggers, and worker_result_*.json anywhere under ActiveProjectRoot) prior to candidate classification.
Ensured agent_owned_candidate_roots and items always serialize as JSON arrays for zero, one, or many roots.
Deduplicated all scanned files by normalized absolute path in a case-insensitive HashSet, guaranteeing summary total matches unique item count.
Validated supplied roots exist and are directories using ErrorAction Stop, failing immediately on missing or file-valued roots.
Added explicit PowerShell 7+ prerequisite check at script startup, causing Windows PowerShell 5.1 to fail immediately with a clear message.

ci_evidence.note: All TASK-0001 regression fixtures passed on the corrected PR candidate. This packet update only records evidence; a follow-up PR regression run is expected on the metadata-only packet commit.

known_limitations: Audit-only policy: no automated file deletion or service/registry modification is performed.
External candidate roots require explicit parameter input.

worker_preflight_evidence.workflow: Cloud Worker Task / TASK-0001 deterministic preflight
worker_preflight_evidence.note: Worker generation, deterministic preflight, allowed-path validation, bundle staging, and artifact upload all completed successfully before PR application.
